simple.meaning: יָכִינִי (Yâkîynîy) is a Hebrew word meaning “a Jakinite (collectively) or descendants of Jakin.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.

simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in יָכִינִי (H3200) before moving outward to related references.
